validation.host: 304 tests passed at the native runtime candidate, one Linux-only test skipped on macOS. All six module/manager host tests also passed after the final app-only fix. The exact native module-store, RC grammar, legacy persist classifier and capability template are executed by tests/test_module_contract.py.
validation.checks: Debug/release Clippy without warnings; apk/shared/stub Android lint; legacy APK assembly passed.
validation.merge_gate: The final PR head must pass its checks. The PR checks page retains exact CI run/job identities; local results are not a waiver.

sdk_scope: Fresh disposable AVDs from installed SDK images; ordinary ramdisk patch, cold boot, setup and subsequent cold boots preserving userdata. Read-only partition overlays and first-consumer timing were measured. No physical Direct Install, OTA, vendor_boot, recovery or EROFS device claim follows from these runs.

mumu.qualification: Fresh sealed qualification passed exact-target/source, init-domain, persistence, backup/restore challenges and stable reports. Every transition used CLI close/open; no adb reboot.
mumu.upgrade: The exact debug APK consumed one-shot authorization through the manager System Mode UI and committed successfully.
mumu.ordinary_lifecycle: Install, policy application/removal, action, timeout/once-only boot-completed, Hide cleanup, disable, update while disabled, enable, interrupted customize, remove/uninstall script, safe-mode and remove-modules recovery passed.
mumu.early_route: Managed System Mode cannot precede early Android init consumers and does not advertise runtime eligibility without MagiskInit/pre-init storage.

mumu.final_app_delta: Only LocalModule and its Android regression test differ from the qualified native candidate; native and System Mode sources are unchanged.

pending_enable_recovery.after_fix: Both enable and disable UI actions updated installed and pending versions

behavioral_evidence.early_timing_and_context: An early-init namespaced service read distinct global/module hosts bytes before the post-fs marker. A real untrusted_app UID then read the global hosts inode. The private source has the original system_file label; public targets are read-only and marker ownership/mode is root/0600. Historical system/vendor input reaches the actual vendor build.prop mount.
behavioral_evidence.ordinary_mounts: AdditionalTest verifies ordinary new files, a deleted stock executable, .replace contents, root API file and symlink, systemless hosts and namespace cleanup. Later Hide namespaces remove ordinary overlays and then the previously covered early bind; base bytes remain visible.
behavioral_evidence.module_lifecycle: A versioned fixture installs, runs action.sh, applies a policy with blank lines/comments, disables, updates while disabled, explicitly enables, survives SIGKILL during customize.sh without activating a partial version, runs uninstall.sh, recovers through safe mode, and removes modules. Immutable old-module-directory injection forces real promotion failure; old ordinary scripts/mounts stay suppressed until the complete pending version can be retried.
behavioral_evidence.boot_completed: ID-ordered once-per-boot scripts, duplicate callback suppression, a sleeping script killed at its ten-second deadline followed by the next module, disable/remove checks and safe-mode exclusion.
behavioral_evidence.snapshot_recovery: Runtime tests cover failed cp, low-space df, sparse 40 MiB payload refusal, unchanged current generation after failure, durable disabled state, repaired refresh, nested payload named manifest, conflict/tampered hash refusal, policy suppression and safe-mode entry. Global remove-modules disable state survives an unrelated refresh.
behavioral_evidence.late_safe_mode: The early consumer can already have run before post-fs-data detects safe mode. The on-boot guarded service is then suppressed and global input remains disabled for the next boot. This is explicitly distinct from an early hardware-key bypass.
behavioral_evidence.storage: No new persist selection; extracted production pre-init C++ tests cover legacy persist spellings and read-only fallback. Actual wrong-device/encrypted-data/slot migration breadth remains PR15. Managed System Mode publishes policy through its owned data file and refuses the early route without MagiskInit/pre-init mapping.
behavioral_evidence.ordering: Ordinary module IDs sort bytewise; the first file wins. Within a module, system/ precedes root/. Early duplicate targets reject the full plan. The historical comparison below explains the intentional versioned conflict migration.

historical_comparison.provenance: R6687BB53-kitsune archive in docs/port-history/assets.json; source-to-APK binding remains unverified.
historical_comparison.scope: Only the archived clone utility ran on disposable synthetic trees using the historical unsorted directory iteration. This is merge-order evidence, not a legacy full-boot or phone qualification.
historical_comparison.node_migration: The old symlink defect was mount-tree classification; valid stored symlinks need no conversion. A genuine 0:0 deletion node stays a whiteout.

explicit_replacements.initrc: Bounded namespaced services and documented events replace unrestricted imports, service overrides, blocking exec/insmod and property loops. Stable modern runtime paths only; movable legacy runtime RC is rejected.
explicit_replacements.early_nodes: Existing regular-file replacement only. New files, symlinks, whiteouts and .replace remain ordinary-mount operations.
explicit_replacements.apex: The historical peer-group experiment and generic root/apex overlay are retired. Use an APEX-aware implementation; no universal namespace/detection promise.
explicit_replacements.private_layout: Private .magisk/block paths are not a module API. Use magisk --preinit-device and the mapped pre-init interface.
explicit_replacements.live_policy: Atomic next-boot publication replaces implicit install-time live mutation, which cannot be reversed by removing the source rule file.
explicit_replacements.template: tools/module-template replaces suffix/inflated-version guards with capability and running-route checks. Archived template bytes/endpoints remain provenance.
explicit_replacements.lite: The single product preserves explicit no-provider/modules-disabled migration. Updating a disabled module never silently enables it.

regressions_fixed.layered_hide: Rescan after detaching a parent overlay so an underlying early mount does not become visible in the hidden namespace.
regressions_fixed.policy_context_barrier: Early sources previously became read-only before label restoration. Keep only private sources writable until contexts are applied, seal the backing tmpfs, and allow RC execution through a ready/safe-mode guard.
regressions_fixed.hidden_staging_path: Stock debug ramdisk temporarily covers the final runtime path. Use the inherited relative staging path for filesystem operations and an explicit final runtime path only for RC consumers.
regressions_fixed.protobuf_codegen: Concurrent ABI builds could read a partly generated shared mod.rs. Generate resetprop protobuf modules in each Cargo OUT_DIR.
regressions_fixed.pending_enable: The real manager UI enabled the installed module but left a safe-mode-disabled pending update disabled. Both manager entry points now synchronize the markers; the pending directory also protects the legacy removal action before the update marker is written.
regressions_fixed.failed_activation: Preserve complete pending updates and suppress the old ordinary module on activation failure; disable pending modules during safe-mode recovery.

lab_failures_and_limits: API 35 virtio input initialized after the early hook. A held emulator volume key did not qualify early hardware-key recovery; retain the durable marker and stock-image recovery path.
An earlier global RC fixture used raw shell dollar expansion rejected by Android init. The validator and tests now reject ambiguous expansion/line folding and use the documented grammar.

Earlier R8/R10 behavioral runs passed assertions but failed during optional log capture (missing file/ADB command quoting). Final capture uses correctly quoted fallback logging; neither earlier overall run is reported successful.
One earlier AVD run timed out during host lid sleep; it is not a product pass or failure. Owned temporary AVDs were removed.

An earlier MuMu qualification rejected a changing target description. The final lifecycle wrapper waits for boot-complete/root/BOOT_VERIFIED readiness and repeats the same checks; no validation condition was relaxed.

A parallel final-candidate lab run hit an ADB transport timeout and a MuMu guest RCU stall before acceptance. The instance engine was stopped after CLI close stalled, a verified test snapshot was restored, and device lanes were rerun sequentially.

The first automated pending-state regression tried to copy module.prop from the metadata-free synthetic mount fixture. It was corrected to create its own metadata before exercising the state transition.

One local full-suite attempt hit macOS EPERM while proving a canceled process group was dead. The host guard failed closed; the isolated regression and subsequent full suite passed. This code was unchanged by PR14.
No physical phone, real OTA, EROFS device, encrypted pre-init recovery, OEM/dlkm partition breadth, or actual SELinux-disabled/Waydroid runtime is inferred. These remain named PR15 qualification.
System Mode remains experimental and debug-only. PR16 owns production signing, historical certificate transitions, release qualification and promotion. No release/feed was published.
